install: set -e; mkdir -p .tools/bin; case "$(uname -m)" in aarch64) p=linux-arm;; *) p=linux;; esac; curl -fsSL https://get.nexte.st/0.9.148/$p | tar -xz -C .tools/bin; cargo fetch
test: set -e; export PATH="$PWD/.tools/bin:$PATH"; mkdir -p reports; cargo nextest run --offline; cp "target/nextest/default/junit.xml" reports/junit.xml
